_comment: Declared manual-only scripts. A script may legitimately be run by hand — but it must SAY SO here, with a reason. Undeclared unreachable scripts fail bin/wiring-audit.py. Created 2026-08-28 after compile-truth-refresh.py, corroborate.py and artifact_utility were each found built-but-never-wired; the shared defect was that nothing checked reachability.

manual_only.bin/repartition-misfiled.py: repair tool — moves entities filed into the wrong Core. Run when a misfile is found, not on a cadence.
manual_only.bin/backfill-artifact-evidence.py: one-time backfill to make already-installed artifacts tunable.
manual_only.bin/reverify-provenance.py: one-time re-classification of pre-fix corpus rows.
manual_only.bin/null-calibration.py: analysis: is a contract's install date special, or would any date show decay. Asked, not scheduled.
manual_only.bin/correction-rate-clean.py: analysis: the defensible correction-rate number. Produces a figure for a human to read.
manual_only.bin/si-record.py: export the loop's real history, anonymized — run when publishing, not nightly.
manual_only.bin/state-shapes.py: fleet analysis of durable-state shapes. Investigative.
manual_only.bin/test-core-manifest.py: test harness for the manifest generator.
manual_only.bin/peer-review-checkout.sh: checks out a peer's branch for review — invoked by a human mid-review.
manual_only.bin/queue-shared-push.sh: queues a shared push; the push itself is the operator's own command by policy (sentinel-code Rule 1).
manual_only.scheduling/brain-pg/teardown-org.py: destructive: drops a Core's partition. Must never be automatic.
manual_only.scheduling/brain-pg/set-scope.py: admin: sets entity scope. Deliberate, manual.
manual_only.scheduling/brain-pg/curate-eval-v2.py: curates the v2 eval set — a judgment task, not a job.
manual_only.scheduling/claude-si/measure-existing-ho: three-stage precision/recall audit toolkit; each stage needs a human between.
manual_only.scheduling/graphify-brain/eval-extractor: extractor evaluation harness. Run when changing extractors.
manual_only.bin/wiring-audit.py: this audit itself — invoked by core-doctor.sh, which the audit cannot see as a caller of itself without recursing.

_should_be_wired._comment: Known-unwired and SHOULD run automatically. Tracked here so they cannot be forgotten again. Moving one of these to a real caller is the fix; deleting it from this list without wiring it is not.
_should_be_wired.scheduling/brain-pg/corroborate.py: WIRED 2026-08-28 into the nightly — cross-Core same_as bridge. Was frozen at 2026-07-07 for 52 days.
_should_be_wired.scheduling/graphify-brain/reconcile-vaul: dedups the brain vault by session/agent identity. Should run on the nightly heavy pass.
_should_be_wired.scheduling/brain-pg/verify-schema-checks: CI guard on schema CHECK constraints. Belongs in core-doctor.
_should_be_wired.bin/guard-conformance.py: cross-Core conformance for pretooluse-guard. Belongs in the fleet health pass.
_should_be_wired.bin/ensure-verdict-contract.py: asserts every sentinel spec carries the canonical verdict contract. Belongs in core-doctor.
_should_be_wired.bin/audit-gap-check.py: every baseline apply must have an audit entry. Belongs in the sync path.
_should_be_wired.bin/corpus-readiness.py: per-seat corpus thresholds for the instruments that read it. Periodic.
_should_be_wired.bin/state-feeder.py: gathers this Core's live operational state. Should feed the OS surface.
_should_be_wired.bin/system-inventory.py: what this Core actually is, derived live. Periodic.
_should_be_wired.scheduling/brain-pg/export-team-brain.py: builds team-brain.json for the Core OS Team Brain tab. Nightly.
_should_be_wired.scheduling/graphify-brain/extract-topics: extraction step for topic/tool nodes — verify whether the pipeline calls it under another name.
